Audience: first-time Hawaii class three applicants, including minors on the graduated path, learning provisional night rules, driver license categories and endorsements, the performance test, renewal, duplicate and restricted licenses, registry, donor and veteran notations, mopeds, license display and citations in plain English.

Prerequisites: the permit, provisional and class three steps from the previous section; this section completes the licensing chapter with the test, renewal and record rules.

Scope note: provisional night driving limits, license categories and commercial endorsements, the performance test and its vehicle requirements, renewal and expiration, duplicates, address and name changes, restricted licenses and restriction codes, the National Driver Register, donor, directive and veteran notations, mopeds, license display and the two kinds of traffic citations. Vehicle equipment and inspection follow in the next section.

Recall emphasis: renewal windows, the thirty-day change rules, weight limits and restriction codes are practiced as recall items; no scenario or recognition surface is needed for this section.
